sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(d.orderqty) AS order_quantity FROM sales.salesorderdetail AS d JOIN sales.salesorderheader AS h ON d.salesorderid = h.salesorderid JOIN production.product AS p ON d.productid = p.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory AS s ON p.productsubcategoryid = s.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory AS c ON s.productcategoryid = c.productcategoryid WHERE h.orderdate >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND h.orderdate < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.productcategoryid, c.name ORDER BY order_quantity DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 200
